verse.text: A youngster's heart is filled with foolishness, but physical discipline will drive it far away.

reflection: Discipline isn't about anger or control — it's about loving your kid enough to do the hard, unpopular work of correcting them now so they don't carry that foolishness into adulthood. The dad who disciplines calmly and consistently is actually giving his children a roadmap toward wisdom, even when it costs him in the moment. Tonight, ask yourself: am I correcting my kids out of frustration, or out of love that's willing to be firm for their good?
